where.if: AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.total_score, p.status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM paper p
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper (title, description, total_score, status, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{totalScore}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, paper_id, question_id, sort, score, question_snapshot FROM paper_question WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY sort
mapper.insert:
